0022600110.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-2, 10th in the West) visit the Denver Nuggets (0-1, 11th in the West) in the Pelicans' third game of the season, with New Orleans still looking for its first win after losing both games so far, including its only road game. New Orleans is listed as day-to-day with a knee injury for Yves Missi, whose status is a game-time decision, while Denver is without Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo is day-to-day with a wrist injury and also a game-time decision. The Pelicans lost 0-3 to Denver in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 122-116 in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, and the two teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
